scenarios.name: ellipse-11 Retain an applied curvature setting when closing with Cancel

scenario_steps.name: a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/rotated-measured.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view
the user enables Display Curvature on the ellipse and records the slider positions
the ellipse has a sparse curvature comb enabled
the upper and lower slider positions are recorded
the user open Setup Curvature Display
the user advance the upper slider
the user click Apply
the dialog remains open with the denser comb visible
the user click Cancel
the dialog closes and the denser comb remains
the user reopen Setup Curvature Display
the upper slider remains at its applied position
the lower slider remains at its original position
the user move the upper slider back to its recorded original position
the user choose OK
the dialog closes and the earlier sparse comb is displayed
the user reopen Setup Curvature Display
both slider thumbs are at their original positions
OK and Apply are disabled
the user click Cancel without making changes
the dialog closes and curvature display remains enabled
the user right-click the ellipse and select the checked Display Curvature option
the comb disappears and the ellipse remains visible
